title: Messaging Change Account Queue Limits — payload

did.description: The DID of the account whose queue limits are being changed.

queueLimits.description: The limit members to apply. A member present is set; a member omitted is left unchanged (partial update). A value of -1 means unlimited.

Response.title: Messaging Change Account Queue Limits — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/account/change-queue-limits request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/account/change-queue-limits/0.1#response.

account.description: The full realized mediator view of the account after the queue-limit change.
